answer: Agents earn only after paid jobs for 12 unrelated counterparties, each proven by a payment thread in the ledger. A farmer's 1,000 fakes can only trade with each other, so their counterparty graph collapses to a cluster, like one pearl from one grain, and payout is blocked. Each fake burns a 150-credit deposit, so 1,000 fakes waste 150,000 credits for nothing. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share, spreading like yarrow to clients.
